title: reminders/<language>.json, <language> zh-CN, ja or ko
description: The texts of map reminders in one language, <language> being zh-CN, ja or ko (zh-Hant is converted from zh-CN), in the translation repository CuleSKY/nerv-translations; English's file, reminders/en.json, has its own schema. Each text is one line in which {variable} stands for a value the reminder fills in, each text with its own variables: it uses every one of them and no other; {{ and }} are literal braces. NERV's backend takes these files when it is released, checking them again. A text left out shows in English.

allOf.description: Uses no variable but {map}; every other brace is doubled

map.description: The map's line when the language has no name for it; {map}: the raw map name

allOf.description: Uses no variable but {map}, {name}; every other brace is doubled

map_with_name.description: The map's line with its name in the language; {map}: the raw map name, {name}: its name

allOf.description: Uses no variable but {players}, {capacity}; every other brace is doubled

players.description: The line of the server's current players; {players}: the players, {capacity}: the server's capacity

allOf.description: Uses no variable but {players}; every other brace is doubled

players_without_capacity.description: The same line for a server whose capacity its source does not tell; {players}: the players

allOf.description: Uses no variable but {server}; every other brace is doubled

server.description: The server's line; {server}: its name, with the community's short name before it unless it begins with the community's name

allOf.description: Uses no variable; every brace is doubled

title.description: The reminder's title, e.g. 换图通知
